subject: Proposal: Accelerated hosted commit + burst window (NovoAI)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Johnson <maya@novoai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Accelerated hosted commit + burst window (NovoAI)

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on the traffic profile you shared and the seasonality spikes tied to campaign launches, I put together a proposal that gets NovoAI onto a higher guaranteed monthly commit while preserving a predictable burst bucket for peak campaign bursts. Key highlights: 

- Monthly committed tokens: 3.5B (up from current 1.2B)
- Burst window: 40% of monthly commit for 3-day contiguous bursts
- Effective per-token rate: see page 2 of the attached (tiered step-down at 2B, 3.5B, 5B)
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for dedicated capacity, 150ms median gen latency target for production endpoints (SLA appendix attached)

I attached an editable proposal and the SLA appendix. If this looks reasonable, I suggest the following next steps:
1) Confirm target start date (we recommended 2025-06-01 to align with July campaigns)
2) Procurement review (Tom) to start contractual redlines
3) Ops alignment for routing/burst configuration and testing

Can you confirm whether NovoAI needs a hard cap on spend in the first 60 days or would prefer soft throttles + alerts? That will change whether we require a pre-funded reserve.

Cheers,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: NovoAI_Redwood_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal, 6 pages), SLA-appendix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Maya Johnson <maya@novoai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@novoai-procurement.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated hosted commit + burst window (NovoAI)

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few clarifying questions from our side before we loop procurement: 

1) Billing predictability: if we hit bursts that exhaust the 40% burst window, how are excess tokens billed? Is there a daily cap option?
2) Trial of higher commit: can we do a 6-week trial at the proposed commit but with the option to rollback to current tier with 14 days' notice?
3) Gamma test: we want to run a staged traffic migration for one product line for 2 weeks — who on the Redwood side would own the routing config?

Also looping Tom on procurement next steps for contract redlines.

-Maya
Maya Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering, NovoAI
maya@novoai.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Johnson <maya@novoai.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@novoai-procurement.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated hosted commit + burst window (NovoAI)

Great questions — answers inline and next actions below.

1) Excess billing: excess tokens beyond the burst window are billed at the overage rate (see table, proposal p.3). We can also set a daily hard cap for the first 30 days if you want stricter spend protection; that requires a pre-funded reserve equal to the cap.

2) Trial: we can run a 6-week pilot with a rollback clause (14d notice). For pilot economics we offer a 10% on-commit credit during the trial to offset migration risk.

3) Gamma/staged migration: Redwood DevOps (Aditya) will own routing and can provide a runbook + one scheduled dry-run with your SREs. Aditya — can you confirm a 48h ops window for the initial traffic ramp?

Next actions:
- Tom to confirm procurement timeline and preferred contract tool (DocuSign/Proprietary)
- Marissa to confirm commercial approval for the 10% trial credit and the discount schedule at 3.5B
- Aditya to schedule a pre-migration ops call with NovoAI SREs

Thanks — I can jump on a call tomorrow if helpful.

Sergio
From: Tom Reyes <procurement@novoai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Johnson <maya@novoai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: NovoAI contract redlines and procurement timeline

Team — attaching the initial redlines from our side. High-level asks: 
- Standard 45-day termination with 30-day notice for pilot period
- Require monthly spend cap for first 60 days (we propose $40k/day)
- Data residency clause: logs must be stored in us-east-1 for 1 year (compliance)

We can accept the 6-week pilot with rollback. Will you circulate a DocuSign envelope once redlines are aligned?

Attachment: NovoAI_contract_redlines.docx (we reference clauses inline)

-Tom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reyes <procurement@novoai.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovoAI contract redlines and procurement timeline

Tom / NovoAI team — thanks for the clear redlines. Internally approved items and notes: 

- Commercial: We can approve the 3.5B commit with the 10% trial on-commit credit for 6 weeks.
- Finance: To honor a daily hard cap of $40k/day for 60 days, we require a refundable security deposit equal to 30 days' cap (proposal: $1.2M) to be posted prior to start. Alternative: automated soft-throttle at $40k/day with email alerts (no deposit) — acceptable for mid-market but enterprise policy requires deposit.
- Data residency: Ops can pin logs to us-east-1; we will provide an audit runbook and access logs for the retention window.
- Legal: 45-day termination with 30-day notice is acceptable for the pilot; any full-commit term will revert to standard annual EULA terms.

If NovoAI can confirm the deposit or accept soft-throttle, we will prepare a DocuSign with the negotiated clauses. Sergio — I will need a final signoff from you for the margin/discount before we send.

-Marissa
From: Tom Reyes <procurement@novoai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Johnson <maya@novoai.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovoAI contract redlines and procurement timeline

Marissa — thanks. NovoAI reviewed options and we'll take the soft-throttle option with alerting for the first 60 days (no deposit). Please proceed with DocuSign and include the 6-week rollback clause. Also include the routing runbook call invite (Maya/SRE) the week prior to start.

We expect signature within 5 business days after DocuSign envelope is sent.

Regards,
Tom Reyes
Head of Procurement, NovoAI
procurement@novoai.com
